excluded.legacy scientific and graphical suites: No existing src/wenu code, catalogue, resource, backend or root runtime dependency changes; no current production consumer imports the SDK or TimeService.
excluded.unrelated providers: No real provider is part of this slice; neither SDK nor test fixtures import one.
excluded.release integration: No product routing or installed combination changes; isolated-wheel evidence is required before this foundation can be accepted. Final integration remains required for K3 production adapters.

collection_change: none; root pytest remains scoped to tests and the kernel retains its explicit independent gate

verification.source_digest_algorithm: SHA-256 over sorted repository path + NUL + exact file bytes + NUL for every Python file in the named directory
fault_injection: wrong TT(TAI)/TAI defining offset fails owning tests
collapsing split JD into binary64 fails owning tests
ignoring conversion model/resource identity fails owning tests
ignoring requested numerical conversion bound fails owning tests

existing_test_changes.change: Also import the time service and optional TT(TAI)/TAI adapter under -I -S; the forbidden dependency assertions are retained.
